name: influencer.profile_list
description: The Instagram accounts the brands of the caller's companies saved as collaborators but no one on the roster holds, as the picture fetch last read them: the handle, the account's own display name, its picture (our own file's path on the core) and its followers. The post page names them with it.
sql: select jsonb_build_object('orgId', p.org_id, 'handle', p.handle, 'name', p.name, 'picture', p.picture, 'followers', p.followers) as result from brandbase.account_profiles p order by p.org_id, p.handle
